name: Product pricing options
summary: A product owner weighing how to price or package a product gets one options brief: what each customer group uses, the willingness-to-pay evidence held with stated kept apart from observed, what each option would bill every account, the uncertainties and the tests. It recommends no price.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for weighing pricing and packaging options, written from its published map of product-management work: fixed inputs under named headers with a stop on any mismatch, stated and observed willingness-to-pay evidence kept apart, an age limit on evidence, a plain bill formula for each option worked for every account, and proposed tests. No third-party text.
